newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran not ready to recognise Taleban yet - Rafsanjani.
newsitem.headline: Iran not ready to recognise Taleban yet - Rafsanjani.

text.p: Iran is not ready yet to recognise the Taleban Islamic movement in neighbouring Afghanistan, President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani said on Sunday.
The Taleban now controls virtually the whole of Afghanistan following the fall of the northern city of Mazar-i-Shari on Saturday.
But Rafsanjani told a news conference: "Our policy has always been for countries officially recognised by the United Nations and in our interest we will consider recognition of that government.
"Thus far, the previous (Afghan) government was recognised at the United Nations. We are awaiting the future."
Iran's Shi'ite Moslem rulers supported the previous Kabul government ousted by the Sunni Taleban, which it criticised for giving Islam a bad name by its harsh interpretation of Islamic law.
